items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: He's pretty good on straight music. I don't mean straight music, but classic. He played a little jump-up stuff.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. What about George McCollum? What kind of trumpet player was he?
He's pretty good on straight music. I don't mean straight music, but classic. He played a little jump-up stuff. He played most of this.
